headline: Kim Ji Woong sets Dec 14 for first EP 'NOISE IN BLUE'
sub: His first EP, announced with an official schedule poster
credit: Photo: Kim Ji Woong official SNS

info.title: Release details
rows: Scheduler out now on his SNS

source: Source: Kim Ji Woong official SNS
caption:
Kim Ji Woong is releasing his first EP, 'NOISE IN BLUE', on Dec 14 at 12 PM KST!

The ZEROBASEONE member shared the news on Nov 23 along with a scheduler for the release. More teasers are set to follow ahead of release day, so keep an eye on his official channels.

📌 Source: Kim Ji Woong official SNS, Soompi
